title: Identify AWS AI/ML Services and Analytics Services

sections.title: What You Are Learning
paragraphs: Each AWS AI, machine learning, and analytics service has a recognizable job. First decide whether the requirement involves intelligence or understanding data, then identify the specific task.
sections.callout: Do I need AI, or do I need to analyze data?

sections.title: Maestro Mental Model
sections.callout: BUILD · TALK · SEARCH · QUERY · STREAM · PREPARE · VISUALIZE

sections.title: AI/ML vs. Analytics
paragraphs: AI and ML services build models or provide intelligent capabilities such as conversation and enterprise search. Analytics services ingest, process, query, transform, or visualize data.
sections.callout: AI/ML = BUILD OR USE INTELLIGENCE · ANALYTICS = UNDERSTAND DATA

sections.title: Amazon SageMaker AI
paragraphs: Amazon SageMaker AI provides managed capabilities to prepare data and build, train, deploy, and operate machine learning models.
sections.callout: Build, train, or deploy an ML model → Amazon SageMaker AI

sections.title: Amazon Lex
paragraphs: Amazon Lex helps build conversational interfaces using voice and text with automatic speech recognition and natural-language understanding.
sections.callout: Chatbot or conversational voice/text interface → Amazon Lex

sections.title: Amazon Kendra
paragraphs: Amazon Kendra uses machine learning to provide intelligent enterprise search across connected organizational content sources.

sections.title: Amazon Athena
paragraphs: Amazon Athena is a serverless interactive query service that uses SQL to analyze data stored directly in Amazon S3.

sections.title: Amazon Kinesis
paragraphs: Amazon Kinesis services ingest and process real-time streaming data such as application events, logs, telemetry, and continuous feeds.
sections.callout: Streaming or continuous real-time data → Amazon Kinesis

sections.title: AWS Glue
paragraphs: AWS Glue is a serverless data-integration service used to discover, prepare, move, and transform data. It also provides the AWS Glue Data Catalog.
sections.callout: ETL or data preparation → AWS Glue

sections.title: Amazon QuickSight
paragraphs: Amazon QuickSight is a managed business-intelligence service for creating interactive visualizations, dashboards, and analyses.
sections.callout: Dashboard, visualization, or business intelligence → Amazon QuickSight

table.caption: Give each analytics service one clear job

sections.title: GSA Scenario Recognition
bullets: Build and train ML models → SageMaker AI
Run SQL queries against S3 → Athena
Perform ETL or transform data → Glue
sections.callout: The task verb identifies the service.

entries.title: SageMaker vs. Lex vs. Kendra
paragraphs: Build ML models → SageMaker. Conversational interface → Lex. Intelligent enterprise search → Kendra.

entries.title: Athena vs. Glue
paragraphs: Query S3 data with SQL → Athena. Prepare and transform data → Glue.

entries.title: Athena vs. QuickSight
paragraphs: SQL analysis → Athena. Dashboards and visualizations → QuickSight.

entries.title: Kinesis vs. Athena
paragraphs: Streaming data → Kinesis. Query S3 with SQL → Athena.

entries.title: Glue vs. QuickSight
paragraphs: ETL and data preparation → Glue. Business intelligence → QuickSight.
